audit_items.proof_trace: The property's premise is false: Decimal uses u256 internally (float.move:12 `value: u256`), not u128. Every arithmetic operation (`mul` at float.move:72-76, `add` at float.move:31-35) calls `ensure_decimal_value_safe`, which bounds results to `VALUE_MAX_256 = U64_MAX * WAD ≈ 1.845×10^37`. With realistic max rates (~4.756×10^-8/sec ≈ 150% APR), triggering the overflow bound would require `dt > 3.88×10^26` seconds—astronomically beyond any practical time horizon. The u256 intermediate product `(VALUE_MAX_256)^2 ≈ 3.4×10^74` also stays well under `u256_max ≈ 1.16×10^77`.
